boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Mary
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with directly verified late availability in Bismarck or on the University of Mary campus.

cards.title: Crow’s Nest Campus Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Lumen Vitae University Center, University of Mary campus
cards.notes: Use the campus restaurant when you need an on-campus option after evening commitments; confirm academic-year versus summer service before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining room with documented around-the-clock academic-year access.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that the Crow’s Nest is open 24/7 during the academic year for students and guests.
cards.source_title: Crow’s Nest Campus Restaurant | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week for students during the academic year; the university lists summer hours as 7 AM–10 PM and notes that hours may vary.

cards.title: IHOP on Brookside Place
cards.subtitle: 1209 Brookside Place, Bismarck, ND 58503
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery from this all-hours location; its official page places it near Brookside Place and University Drive.
cards.short_summary: An all-day breakfast and meal stop with 24-hour daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 1209 Brookside Place Bismarck restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast Restaurant Near You in Bismarck, at 1209 Brookside Place
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Monday–Sunday as open 24 hours, with dine-in and late-night food amenities.

cards.entity_name: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery — 100 E Bismarck Expressway
cards.title: Perkins on Bismarck Expressway
cards.subtitle: 100 E Bismarck Expressway, Bismarck, ND 58504
cards.notes: Use this restaurant-and-bakery location for a late meal or bakery stop; check the location page again before departure if plans change.
cards.short_summary: A Bismarck Expressway restaurant listed until 2 AM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists its 100 E Bismarck Expressway location’s restaurant hours as 5:30 AM–2 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 100 E Bismarck Expressway Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours of 5:30 AM–2 AM, Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: McDonald’s on State Street
cards.subtitle: 2631 State St, Bismarck, ND 58501
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a round-the-clock stop; the official page distinguishes its 24-hour drive-thru from lobby hours ending at 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A State Street location with a 24-hour drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists the drive-thru at 2631 State St as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald’s at 2631 State St, Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed as open 24 hours daily; the restaurant lobby is listed 5 AM–11 PM daily.

cards.title: Wendy’s Bismarck North
cards.subtitle: 3120 N. 14th St., Bismarck, ND 58503
cards.notes: Plan for late drive-thru or restaurant service at this north Bismarck location; Friday and Saturday have the latest listed close, at 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A north Bismarck quick-service restaurant open through 1 or 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists this Bismarck location open until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s Bismarck North at 3120 N. 14th St.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 800 South Washington, Bismarck, ND 58504
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late pickup at this south Bismarck address; dining-room service ends earlier, so do not rely on indoor seating late.
cards.short_summary: A South Washington drive-thru listed through 1 AM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 800 South Washington as open 7 AM–1 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 800 South Washington, Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed as 7 AM–1 AM daily; dine-in hours are listed through 11 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Rock Island Place
cards.subtitle: 2616 Rock Island Place, Bismarck, ND 58504
cards.notes: Use this Rock Island Place drive-thru for a late order; indoor hours end earlier, so verify the ordering mode before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Rock Island Place drive-thru with daily 1 AM closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 2616 Rock Island Place as open 7 AM–1 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 2616 Rock Island Place, Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 7 AM–1 AM daily; the official page lists dine-in hours through 11 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on State Street
cards.subtitle: 3310 State Street, Bismarck, ND 58501
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes; the official location page lists late service daily but separately shows earlier indoor hours.
cards.short_summary: A State Street drive-thru open until 1 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 3310 State Street as open 9 AM–1 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 3310 State Street, Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 9 AM–1 AM daily; the dining room is listed until 11 PM.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South 12th Street
cards.subtitle: 1012 S 12th St, Bismarck, ND 58504
cards.notes: Place a delivery or carryout order for this South 12th Street location; its official listing shows midnight service most nights and 1 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery location open through midnight or 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists its 1012 S 12th St Bismarck location until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut at 1012 S 12th St, Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed until 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Applebee’s on South 3rd
cards.subtitle: 434 South 3rd, Bismarck, ND 58504
cards.notes: Use this all-ages restaurant for a late seated meal, takeout, delivery, or Carside To Go; verify availability before arriving near closing.
cards.short_summary: A South 3rd restaurant with midnight closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee’s lists its 434 South 3rd Bismarck restaurant as open until 12 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Applebee’s Grill + Bar in Bismarck, ND
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours from 10:30 AM until 12 AM Monday–Sunday, with dine-in and takeout services.
